output.summary: Incidents rose far faster than volume (+7%) and the EU share is small. The tool migration only affected SEV3-SEV4, and the SEV1-SEV2 criteria are unchanged. The best-supported driver is a reinforcing loop: interrupt load defers reliability work, and overdue action items then recur as incidents. Storage's exemption is a quasi-experiment: it closed its items and its incidents and pages fell while traffic was flat. Networking's second-slot pilot did not help. Acknowledgement times were unchanged, few incidents overlapped, and on-call frequency worsened. Attrition has mixed causes (pay and on-call), so causation is unclear. Ring-fencing engineers to close the overdue items is preferred. A second primary slot and rating-linked incident targets are harmful. A pay-only response is premature.
